rocket_leap.name: Rocket Leap

energy_shield.name: Energy Shield

furnace_cleave.name: Furnace Cleave

coolant_flush.name: Coolant Flush

magnetic_pull.name: Magnetic Pull
magnetic_pull.desc: A magnetic burst that drags nearby enemies to you and stuns them briefly.

heat_vent.name: Heat Vent

orbital_strike.name: Orbital Strike
orbital_strike.desc: Call down an orbital strike at the cursor. After a short warning it deals massive damage, stuns and makes enemies Vulnerable.

quick_shot.name: Quick Shot
quick_shot.desc: A fast shot at the cursor. Generates Focus.

vibro_slash.name: Vibro Slash

piercing_shot.name: Piercing Shot
piercing_shot.desc: A heavy round that passes through every enemy in a line.

pistol_barrage.name: Pistol Barrage
pistol_barrage.desc: Fire a fan of five pistol rounds. Devastating up close.

holo_decoy.name: Holo Decoy
holo_decoy.desc: Project a hologram that enemies nearby attack instead of you.

smoke_cloak.name: Smoke Cloak
smoke_cloak.desc: Vanish in smoke for 4 seconds: enemies lose track of you and your next hit is a guaranteed critical strike. Heals 10% of your life and removes stuns and slows.

phase_shift.name: Phase Shift
phase_shift.desc: Blink to the cursor, briefly untouchable.

minefield.name: Minefield
minefield.desc: Throw three mines that arm after a moment and explode when enemies step close, stunning them.

cluster_grenade.name: Cluster Grenade
cluster_grenade.desc: Throw a grenade that explodes, sets enemies on fire and scatters bomblets.

death_mark.name: Death Mark
death_mark.desc: Mark every enemy in a wide area for 10 seconds. Marked enemies take 25% more damage and refund 15 Focus when they die.

spore_dart.name: Spore Dart
spore_dart.desc: Fire a poisoned spore dart. Generates Biomass.

scalpel_slash.name: Scalpel Slash
scalpel_slash.desc: A quick scalpel slash that heals you for 8% of the damage dealt. Generates Biomass.

spore_burst.name: Spore Burst
spore_burst.desc: Release a cloud of spores at the cursor that poisons enemies inside it for 5 seconds.

parasite_link.name: Parasite Link
parasite_link.desc: Latch onto the enemy nearest the cursor for 3 seconds, draining its life and healing you for 25% of the damage.

chitin_armor.name: Chitin Armor
chitin_armor.desc: Harden your skin for 6 seconds: take 30% less damage, and melee attackers are hurt.

spore_cocoon.name: Spore Cocoon
spore_cocoon.desc: Wrap yourself in a fungal cocoon: a barrier of 25% of your life, heal 10% and remove stuns and slows.

raise_corpse.name: Raise Corpse
raise_corpse.desc: Raise up to 2 corpses near the cursor as minions that fight for you (up to 6). Needs corpses.

grasping_tendrils.name: Grasping Tendrils
grasping_tendrils.desc: Tendrils burst from the ground at the cursor, holding enemies in place for 2 seconds and poisoning them.

corpse_explosion.name: Corpse Explosion
corpse_explosion.desc: Detonate up to 3 corpses near the cursor in toxic blasts. Needs corpses.

wrath_of_lumen.name: Wrath of Lumen
wrath_of_lumen.desc: A colossal Lumen creature erupts at the cursor for 12 seconds. It draws enemies to itself and slams everything around it.

bastion.tagline: Heavy melee in a battered exoskeleton
bastion.desc: A former security marine who stands in the middle of the fight. Bastion builds Heat by hitting and being hit, and spends it on crushing blows — but stay at max Heat too long and the suit overheats.

spectre.desc: A sniper and saboteur who fights with mobility, precision and traps. Focus refills on its own, and faster on critical hits and dodged attacks. Rifles, twin pistols and vibroblades.

xenomant.desc: A former biologist infected with Lumen who can command it. Biomass gathered from the dead raises servants and spreads spores. Forbidden power, with a price.

0.title: Escape pod flight recorder
0.body: Pod 3 of the Halcyon relay. Distress call received from Kharos IV, Governor's seal attached. Atmospheric entry nominal. Correction: entry not nominal. Debris field over the landing zone. Brace. Brace. Brace.

1.title: Scrawled on a lander hatch
1.body: WE WAITED THREE DAYS FOR THE EVAC SHUTTLE. IT NEVER CAME. GONE EAST TO THE FUEL STATION. IF YOU CAN READ THIS, DON'T DRINK THE WATER FROM THE CRATERS. – T.

2.title: Dr. Ines Okafor – personal log 1
2.body: The crystals in the deep core samples aren't inert. Under the scope they move, slowly, toward heat. I filed a report with the Governor's office. They thanked me for my diligence and asked me to keep the samples sealed.

3.title: Convoy driver's data pad
3.body: Route 7 is closed at the checkpoint. Soldiers say there's a quarantine. Nobody says what for. We've been idling for nine hours and the ash is getting into the filters. Marta keeps coughing. She says it's just the ash.

4.title: Outpost Ember notice board
4.body: RULES OF EMBER: 1. Nobody sleeps outside the ring. 2. Anyone with green in their eyes leaves. No arguments. 3. The cook decides the rations. 4. Keep the generator running. The light keeps them away. Mostly.

5.title: Dr. Ines Okafor – personal log 2
5.body: Second report ignored. Three drill crew from Shaft 9 are in the infirmary with a fever and green veins under their fingernails. The Governor says the drills keep running. Quotas from the Consortium. I said people will die. He said people already are.

6.title: Mining foreman's audio log
6.body: Shift change. The dogs won't go into the lower tunnels anymore. Brix bit a handler today, that dog has never bitten anyone. Its gums were glowing. I put it down myself. Had to use the whole clip.

7.title: Dr. Ines Okafor – personal log 3
7.body: I've named it Lumen, for the light. It isn't a disease. It is a network. Every infected host is a node, and the nodes talk to each other. Whatever is at the bottom of the mine is listening to all of them.

8.title: Freighter Meridian – bridge log
8.body: Meridian to Kharos traffic: we're taking on refugees, three hundred, no room for more. Spore contamination detected in cargo bay two. Sealing bulkheads. Engines unresponsive. Going down near the elevator foundation. Tell my daughter—

9.title: Dr. Ines Okafor – personal log 4
9.body: Patient zero was Elias Brandt, the first colonist to touch an exposed vein in Shaft 1. He didn't die. They moved him to a sealed pit north of the checkpoint and stopped feeding him. Something down there is still growing.

10.title: Checkpoint Sierra standing orders
10.body: By order of Governor Kade: no civilian traffic past Sierra. Anyone showing signs of infection is to be detained, not treated. Weapons free on non-compliant persons. Drill operations are to continue uninterrupted. – Commandant R. Hale

11.title: Dr. Ines Okafor – personal log 5
11.body: They're coming for my notes. If someone finds this: the Governor knew. He had my reports a full month before the first evacuation order, and he kept the drills running. The mine isn't a mine anymore. It's a door. Don't let them open it wider.

benny.name: Benny Rusk
benny.title: Cook · Trader
benny.greeting: Sit down before you fall down. There's soup. Don't ask what's in it.

hekla.name: Hekla Strand
hekla.title: Former miner · Blacksmith
hekla.greeting: If it's broken, I can fix it. If it's rotten, I can't. Which is it?

pell.name: Pell Varga
pell.title: Data engineer · Technician
pell.greeting: Careful with the cables. Half the outpost runs through this desk.

tomas.name: Tomas Reyes
tomas.title: Survivor
tomas.greeting: Have you seen a girl out there? Sixteen. Red jacket. Her name is Lena.

danner.name: Pvt. Danner
danner.title: Deserter
danner.greeting: Don't shoot. Please. I'm not one of them. Not yet.

wake_up.title: Wake Up
wake_up.summary: The pod came down hard in the Impact Fields. Get out of the crater and find a way forward.

steps.0: Climb out of the crater and reach the road
steps.2: Activate the teleporter at the edge of the Impact Fields

wake_up.done: The teleporter hums awake. Somewhere east, a light is burning.

signal.title: Signal in the Ash
signal.summary: A light burns to the east along Route 7. Someone kept a fire going.
signal.talk1:
You came down in that pod? Then you're the answer to the Governor's distress call. Funny. Nobody here sent it.
This is Outpost Ember. A fuel station, nine survivors, and a generator that keeps the dark at arm's length.
Rest. Then make yourself useful. Everyone here does.

fuel.title: Fuel for the Living
fuel.summary: The generator is running dry. Without light, Ember falls in a night.

steps.1: Find the stranded convoy on Route 7
steps.2: Clear the infected around the convoy ({n}/{count})

fuel.offer:
The generator's got two days of fuel. Maybe three if we sit in the dark.
A convoy got stuck on Route 7 when the quarantine started. Tankers full of it.
Talk to Hekla. She knows what we need and how to carry it.
fuel.talk0:
Benny sent you? Good. My hands are better at fixing than fighting these days.
The convoy's east on Route 7, past the overpass. It'll be crawling. Bring me three canisters, sealed.
fuel.talk4:
Sealed and full. That's three more weeks of light.
You fight like someone who's done it before. Don't tell me where. Pell wants a word, by the way. Something on the radio.
fuel.done: The generator roars back to life. For now, Ember stays lit.

orders.title: The Governor's Orders
orders.summary: Pell has decrypted traffic from Checkpoint Sierra. The soldiers there were following orders long after they stopped being human.

steps.0: Reach the approach to Checkpoint Sierra

orders.offer:
I've been listening to the military band. Checkpoint Sierra is still broadcasting. Same orders, every hour, signed by Governor Kade.
No civilian traffic. Detain the infected. Keep the drills running.
Whoever's still there isn't taking orders from anyone alive. Take the checkpoint back and we get the archive. Then we know what he knew.
orders.talk2:
Hale. Commandant Hale. I went to school with his son.
The archive's intact. The orders are real. Kade knew about the infection a month before the first evacuation call, and he kept the drills going.
There's more in the Meridian's flight data. If the black box survived, it'll show us what he was shipping.
orders.done: The checkpoint is quiet. The archive is not.

black_box.title: Black Box
black_box.summary: The freighter Meridian went down near the elevator foundation. Its black box may show what the Governor was shipping out.

steps.0: Reach the wreck of the Meridian
steps.1: Recover the black box from Meridian's Hold
steps.2: Bring the black box to Pell

black_box.offer:
The Meridian was the last ship off the surface. It never made orbit.
Its black box logs cargo manifests. If Kade was moving something out of the mine, it's in there.
The hold has no power. Get the generators running and bring me that box.
black_box.talk2:
Cargo bay two: one sealed container, Consortium priority, origin Shaft 1. No contents listed.
Shaft 1 is where it started. Where they put the first one. Elias Brandt.
They didn't kill him. They sealed him in a pit north of the checkpoint. Locals call it the Maw. Whatever's growing there... it's what they were trying to ship.
black_box.done: The box goes quiet. Its last word was a destination: the Maw.

the_first.title: The First
the_first.summary: Patient zero still lives in the Maw. Everything the infection knows, it learned from him.
the_first.offer:
Every infected thing out there moves like it's listening to something. Okafor called it a network.
If the first node goes dark, maybe the rest go deaf. Maybe not.
It's the only idea we've got. Go to the Maw.
the_first.talk2:
You're back. That means it's dead. Or you are, and this is the soup talking.
Pell read me the rest of the logs. Kade knew. He kept the drills running because the Consortium paid by the ton, and the dead don't file complaints.
The refinery's still burning out east. If he's anywhere, he's there. Eat first.
the_first.done: The Maw is silent. The refinery fire still lights the horizon.

daughter.title: A Daughter Lost
daughter.summary: Tomas Reyes lost his daughter Lena in Ash Valley when the storms began.

steps.0: Search Ash Valley where Lena was last seen

daughter.offer:
She went out for water. Ash Valley. The storm came in and she didn't come back.
That was eleven days ago. I know what that means. I'm asking anyway.
Please. Just... find out.
daughter.talk3:
That's her locket. Her mother's picture.
Was she... was it quick? No. Don't answer. Thank you for not lying to me.
I'll put it with her mother's things. Leave me a while.
daughter.done: Some answers are only kindness because the questions were worse.

logs.title: The Scientist's Logs
logs.summary: Dr. Ines Okafor warned the Governor months before the fall. Her logs are scattered across Cinder Flats.
logs.talk1:
Okafor. She used to come in for coffee and leave her samples on my desk. I complained.
She saw all of it coming, and they buried her reports. I'll copy these to every channel we still have.
She left something with me before she disappeared. Said to give it to whoever finished reading. Here.
logs.done: Dr. Okafor's warnings are finally heard. Too late, but heard.

water.title: Water for Ember
water.summary: A water tanker sits abandoned on Route 7, half full. Ember is rationing every cup.

steps.0: Find the water tanker on Route 7
steps.1: Escort the tanker to Outpost Ember

water.offer:
There's a tanker on Route 7, west of the overpass. Half full, last I saw it.
It still drives. Barely. Walk it back here and keep the infected off it.
It only moves if somebody's with it. The autopilot's scared of the dark too.
water.talk2:
Clean water. Well. Cleaner water.
That's soup for a month. And tea, if Hekla stops hoarding the leaves.

spices.title: Cook's Spices
spices.summary: Benny swears the glands of Spore Carriers taste like pepper, if you boil them long enough.
spices.offer:
Everything tastes like ash. Everything.
The Spore Carriers... the glands on their backs. Boiled for six hours, they taste like black pepper. Don't look at me like that.
Bring me three. People need a reason to come to dinner.
spices.talk1:
Perfect. Disgusting. Perfect.
Tonight nobody's eating ash. Tonight it's pepper and ash.
spices.done: For one evening, Ember eats something that tastes like home.

old_dog.title: Old Dog
old_dog.summary: Hekla had a mining dog named Rook. It ran when the tunnels went dark.

steps.0: Search the old kennels in the Impact Fields

old_dog.offer:
I had a dog. Rook. Best tunnel dog in Shaft 4, he could smell gas before the sensors.
He ran when it started. Somebody saw a hound like him by the old kennels in the Impact Fields. Glowing.
If it's him... don't let him stay like that. Bring me his collar.
old_dog.talk3:
That's his. I stamped the tag myself.
He'd have hated being one of them. Thank you. I mean it.
Go on. I'm fine. I've got work.
old_dog.done: Rook's collar hangs on a nail above Hekla's anvil.

radio.title: Radio Silence
radio.summary: Pell needs three relay masts repaired to hear the rest of the planet.
radio.offer:
Three relay masts around Route 7 went dark in the first week.
Get them running and I can hear the whole basin. Survivors. Soldiers. Whatever's left.
The terminals just need a reset. Power cycle. Hit them if you have to.
radio.talk1:
I've got signal. Static mostly. And... a woman counting numbers in the refinery band. Over and over.
I'll keep listening. Thank you. It's less quiet now.
radio.done: The radio crackles with voices again, few and far between.

rations.title: Rations Run
rations.summary: The convoys left supply crates all along Route 7.

steps.0: Open supply crates in the wild ({n}/{count})

rations.offer:
The convoys left crates up and down Route 7. Ration packs, med gel, whatever.
Crack open three of them and bring me back word of what's out there. Keep whatever you find.
rations.talk1: Good. The road still feeds us, then. For now.
rations.done: The road still has something left to give.

deserter.title: The Deserter
deserter.summary: A soldier fled Checkpoint Sierra before it fell. Hekla heard he hides near the southern bunker.

steps.0: Find the deserter near the southern bunker
steps.1: Decide what to do with Pvt. Danner

deserter.offer:
There's a soldier hiding near the bunker south of the road. Deserted from Sierra before it went bad.
Some here want him hanged for what the soldiers did. Some want his rifle.
Find him. What happens after is your call.
deserter.done: Pvt. Danner made his choice. So did you.

choice1.prompt:
I ran when they started shooting civilians. I'm not proud of it. I'm not sorry either.
Send me to Ember and I'll pull my weight. Or take the rifle and leave me. Your call.
choice1.spare: Go to Ember. Earn your place.

result.spare: Danner heads toward the light of Ember, rifle slung, head down.
result.rifle: Danner leaves the rifle in the ash and walks into the dark without looking back.

lights.title: Lights Out
lights.summary: The beacons on the Sierra road went out. Without them, nobody finds their way back at night.
lights.offer:
The road beacons toward Sierra are dark. Four of them.
They're on a separate circuit, so they just need the switch thrown. Light them and people can find Ember after dark again.
lights.talk1:
I can see them from the roof. Four little stars on the road.
Somebody's going to make it home tonight because of that.
lights.done: Four beacons burn on the Sierra road.

letter.title: Last Letter
letter.summary: A body in Ash Valley clutches a letter addressed to Outpost Ember.
letter.talk0:
This is my brother's hand. Martin.
He says he's sorry about the restaurant. That he's going to walk to Ember. That I should keep a bowl warm.
I kept a bowl warm. Eleven days. Thank you for bringing him the rest of the way.
letter.done: Benny keeps the letter in his apron pocket.

whistle.title: The Whistle in the Ash
whistle.summary: A tin whistle lies in the ash. When the wind passes through it, something whistles back.

steps.2: Follow the whistle to its end
steps.3: Open what the whistle was guarding

whistle.done: Whoever left the whistle wanted someone to follow it.
